annotations.title: Agent test (can an AI agent use this website?)

description: Agent test: a real browser agent starts at a website with one task (find the price, find where to sign up, understand the product, find help, or your own) and reports whether it got there, each step it took, where it got stuck and what to change. Use when a site owner asks whether AI agents can use their website, or before sending your own agent to a site you don't know. The agent only follows what the pages show; it never signs in, signs up, pays or sends a form, so reaching a sign-up or checkout page counts as done. Takes 20-120 seconds. Returns verdict (done, stuck or blocked), headline, summary, answer (what it found), stuckAt, steps[] {n, how, url, actions[], ok, landed, stopped, note} taken from the real browser calls, fixes[] {title, why, how} and fixPrompt, a copy-paste prompt for an AI coding tool. Not charged when no page could be opened. Price: $0.05 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails.

custom.description: With task custom: what the agent should try to do, in one sentence (8-300 characters)

url.description: The website to test, e.g. myapp.com

name: agent_test

answer.description: What the agent found; empty when not done

fixPrompt.description: Copy-paste prompt for an AI coding tool

judged.description: False when the agent ran out of time before giving a verdict

ran.description: False when no page could be opened

steps.description: From the real browser calls, in order

stuckAt.description: Where it stopped; empty when done

taskId.description: price, signup, what, contact or custom
